2607.17890.title: Stress Testing Concept Erasure with Large Language Model Agents
2607.17890.paper_summary: Concept erasure aims to remove semantic concepts from a trained generative model and is increasingly important for responsible AI deployment. However, verifying whether a model has robustly removed targeted concepts remains a critical challenge. Existing evaluation methods are typically pre-defined and static, failing to expose vulnerabilities under diverse natural-language probes and challenging conditions. Moreover, manually designed evaluation strategies can be biased and difficult to scale. We posit that concept erasure evaluation is best formulated as an adaptive hypothesis search, operationalised by agents that iteratively propose, critique, and verify tests to systematically expand coverage of failure modes. To this end, we propose Stress Testing Agents for Concept Erasure (STACE), a framework that autonomously stress-tests concept-erased models using multiple Large Language Model (LLM) agents, by iteratively generating and verifying stress-testing hypotheses grounded by external knowledge. We also introduce a suite of metrics for assessing the performance and efficiency of LLM-agent-powered stress-testing frameworks. Our extensive experiments show that STACE outperforms five LLM-based evaluation baselines on four concept categories. Further analysis across two T2I models, six concept erasure approaches, and various erasure strengths show that STACE is robust for different settings. We also show that STACE can be adapted beyond concept erasure evaluation to other problem domains, such as LLM jailbreaking. Our code is available anonymously.
2607.17890.paper_summary_zh: 概念抹除旨在從訓練過的生成模型中移除語義概念，並且在負責任的人工智慧部署中變得越來越重要。<lb/>然而，驗證模型是否穩健地移除了目標概念仍然是一個關鍵挑戰。<lb/>現有的評估方法通常是預先定義的和靜態的，無法在多樣的自然語言探測和挑戰條件下揭示脆弱性。<lb/>此外，手動設計的評估策略可能存在偏見且難以擴展。<lb/>我們認為，概念抹除評估最好被表述為一種自適應假設搜索，由代理人操作，這些代理人不斷提出、批評和驗證測試，以系統性地擴展失敗模式的覆蓋範圍。<lb/>為此，我們提出了概念抹除壓力測試代理（STACE），這是一個框架，通過多個大型語言模型（LLM）代理自主地對概念抹除模型進行壓力測試，通過不斷生成和驗證基於外部知識的壓力測試假設。<lb/>我們還介紹了一套指標，用於評估LLM代理驅動的壓力測試框架的性能和效率。<lb/>我們的廣泛實驗表明，STACE在四個概念類別上超越了五個基於LLM的評估基準。<lb/>對兩個T2I模型、六種概念抹除方法和各種抹除強度的進一步分析顯示，STACE在不同設置下都具有穩健性。<lb/>我們還顯示，STACE可以適應於概念抹除評估之外的其他問題領域，例如LLM越獄。<lb/>我們的代碼可匿名獲取。
